tools.name: economic_get_self
tools.description: The agreement behind the grant token: agreement number and type, company details, the user, the app and the enabled modules. Use it to confirm which company the tools read. GET /self.

tools.name: economic_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with optional filter, pagesize and skippages. Returns customer numbers, names, contact data and balances. GET /customers.

tools.name: economic_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by customer number: contacts, delivery locations, terms, group, VAT zone and totals. GET /customers/{customerNumber}.

tools.name: economic_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer. Name, customer group, VAT zone and payment terms are needed; read the numbers with the list tools first. Writes master data to the company's books. POST /customers.

tools.name: economic_list_booked_invoices
tools.description: List booked (issued) invoices with optional filter, e.g. date$gte:2026-01-01 or customer filters where the API allows. GET /invoices/booked.

tools.name: economic_get_booked_invoice
tools.description: One booked invoice by number: customer, amounts, VAT, due date, lines and whether it was sent. GET /invoices/booked/{bookedInvoiceNumber}.

tools.name: economic_list_unpaid_invoices
tools.description: Booked invoices that are not paid yet (not yet due or overdue). GET /invoices/unpaid.

tools.name: economic_list_overdue_invoices
tools.description: Booked invoices past their due date that are not paid. GET /invoices/overdue.

tools.name: economic_list_draft_invoices
tools.description: Draft invoices that are not booked yet. GET /invoices/drafts.

tools.name: economic_get_draft_invoice
tools.description: One draft invoice by number, with its lines. GET /invoices/drafts/{draftInvoiceNumber}.

tools.name: economic_create_draft_invoice
tools.description: Create a DRAFT invoice for a customer with its lines. It is not booked and not sent: a person books it in e-conomic. The recipient, currency, payment terms and layout come from the customer unless given. Every line needs a product number and a description; e-conomic accepts a price only on a line wi

tools.name: economic_list_products
tools.description: List products and services with optional filter: number, name, prices and barred state. GET /products.

tools.name: economic_get_product
tools.description: One product by product number: name, description, prices, unit, product group and inventory. GET /products/{productNumber}.

tools.name: economic_create_product
tools.description: Create a product or service with a unique product number, a name and a sales price. POST /products.

tools.name: economic_list_accounts
tools.description: The chart of accounts: account number, name, type, balance and debit or credit side. GET /accounts.

tools.name: economic_get_account
tools.description: One account by account number, with its balance and links to accounting years. GET /accounts/{accountNumber}.

tools.name: economic_list_journals
tools.description: Journals (kladder) that vouchers are posted to. GET /journals.

tools.name: economic_list_journal_vouchers
tools.description: Vouchers (drafts) in one journal. GET /journals/{journalNumber}/vouchers.

tools.name: economic_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers with optional filter. GET /suppliers.

tools.name: economic_get_supplier
tools.description: One supplier by supplier number. GET /suppliers/{supplierNumber}.

tools.name: economic_list_currencies
tools.description: Currencies enabled on the agreement, with ISO codes and exchange rates. GET /currencies.

tools.name: economic_list_payment_terms
tools.description: Payment terms with their numbers (used when creating customers and invoices). GET /payment-terms.

tools.name: economic_list_vat_zones
tools.description: VAT zones (domestic, EU, abroad, …) with their numbers. GET /vat-zones.

tools.name: economic_list_customer_groups
tools.description: Customer groups with their numbers (required when creating a customer). GET /customer-groups.

tools.name: economic_list_product_groups
tools.description: Product groups with their numbers (used when creating products). GET /product-groups.

tools.name: economic_list_units
tools.description: Units of measure with their numbers (used on products and invoice lines). GET /units.

tools.name: economic_list_layouts
tools.description: Invoice and document layouts with their numbers. GET /layouts.

tools.name: economic_list_accounting_years
tools.description: Accounting years with their start and end dates and status. GET /accounting-years.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: economic_create_customer, economic_create_draft_invoice · Private data: economic_get_self, economic_list_customers, economic_get_customer, economic_list_layouts · Public sink: economic_create_customer, economic_create_draft_invoice, economic_create_product.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: economic_create_customer, economic_create_draft_invoice · Private data: economic_get_self, economic_list_customers, economic_get_customer, economic_list_layouts · Public sink: economic_create_customer, economic_create_draft_invoice, economic_create_product

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
